title: Daryl Pack Resolution v0.1
description: Outputs of resolve(packs: Set, evaluated_at: Instant, resolver_version: Str) -> Resolved(manifest, trace) | Refused(refusals). Governed by ADR-PACK-0001. Resolution is a pure function: no clock, no I/O, no locale, no filesystem order, no randomness. Hashing is dsm_primitives.hash_canonical over ADR-0002 canonical JSON — no new hashing law is introduced.

hash_v1.description: ADR-0002 canonical hash. Unknown prefixes fail closed.

pack_ref.description: pack_id@pack_version — the citable unit of governed rules (ADR-PRL-0014 R3).

refusal_code.description: Closed taxonomy, ten codes (ADR-PACK-0001 R11). An unrecognized code fails closed: a consumer that cannot type a refusal must treat it as refusal, never as success.

effective_manifest.description: The canonical result of a successful resolution. Contains NOTHING order-dependent, no execution timestamp, no host, no filesystem path. Its hash is the value cited by every downstream receipt.

evaluated_at.description: An explicit INPUT, never now(). A resolver that reads the wall clock is non-conforming (R8).

proof_scope.description: The sections this manifest actually composed. v0.1 is exactly ['required_checks','vocabulary']; reserved sections are neither composed nor hashed.

context.description: Referent values DECLARED by the pack set, collected and canonically sorted. Never inferred, never defaulted; an absent referent is an empty list (unknown), which is not 'universal'.

packs.description: The pack set, canonically sorted by (layer_rank, pack_id, pack_version). This ordering is REPORTING ONLY and may never arbitrate a value (R7).

sections.description: The composed governed content, in-proof-scope sections only.

resolution_trace.description: The full trace. Stored as a content-addressed artifact keyed by its own v1 hash (R12); NEVER embedded in a receipt.

resolver_version.description: Carried once here and once in the manifest, not repeated per entry: it is constant per resolution, and repeating it inflates a content-addressed artifact without adding information.

selected_from.description: Every pack whose contribution survives in the effective value. Canonically sorted.

overridden_sources.description: Every pack whose contribution did NOT survive. Canonically sorted. Non-empty means this path is contested in the composition sense (R14) — which is NOT MEF.contested.

derogation_applied.description: The derogation consumed to permit this override, if any. null when none was needed.

resolution_refusal.description: The other lawful outcome. Phase-staged: the FIRST phase producing any refusal terminates resolution and reports EVERY refusal of that phase, canonically sorted by (code, path, pack_refs) — 'first error encountered' is order-dependent and therefore forbidden (R9). This object is canonically hashed, so 'the same typed refusal' is a hash equality, not a judgement call.

path.description: The contested leaf path, or "" for refusals that are not path-scoped (P1/P2).

detail.description: Canonical, machine-comparable discriminators only. Free prose here would break hash equality between independent implementations.

pack_loaded_receipt.description: Act 1 of 3: a pack entered the process. Per Rule A, issued only after DSMWriter.write() returns non-None.

source_ref.description: Opaque. A referent is never its carrier: this is provenance, never identity and never precedence.

pack_resolution_receipt.description: Act 2 of 3: a rule set was composed. Carries HASHES, VERSIONS, OUTCOME and CONTESTED FIELDS inline — and nothing else. No effective values, no trace entries, no pack bodies: a receipt is a citation, not a copy (R13).

contested_paths.description: Sorted. Paths whose resolution overrode a lower-layer value or consumed a derogation. A COMPOSITION fact — unrelated to MEF.contested (ADR-PRL-0011), never merged with it, never derived from it (R14).

work_receipt_pack_binding.description: Act 3 of 3, the binding fragment ONLY. swarm.v0.1's WorkReceipt / ReviewReceipt are NOT redefined here: this fragment is what a work receipt adds to cite the rules that governed it. The three never-merged axes (required_checks / claimed_checks / actual_checks) stay exactly as they are, with coverage computed in replay and never trusted from the author.
